item.title: Top 2 Differences Between AWS Boto and Boto3
item.description:
AWS offers two key Python libraries for interacting with their services: Boto and Boto3. Many developers encounter confusion regarding these packages, especially when deciding which one to use in their projects. Let’s delve deeper into the distinctions between AWS Boto and Boto3, shedding light on their features, usage, and capabilities.

What are Boto and Boto3?

Boto: Initially developed as a Python library for Amazon Web Services (AWS), it was designed to provide simple access to AWS resources. However, due to its hand-coded nature, it became increasingly complex to maintain. Furthermore, Boto is no longer officially supported, leading to the necessity for developers to migrate to more modern solutions.
